definitions.explanation: A thin sphere of liquid enclosing air.
A mass of small bubbles on a liquid surface.

examples.japanese: {石鹸|せっけん}の{泡|あわ}を{立|た}てる。
ビールの{泡|あわ}が{消|き}えた。

notes:
{泡|あわ} refers to bubbles and foam.

EXPRESSIONS:
- {泡|あわ}を{食|く}う: to be flustered
- {泡|あわ}と{消|き}える: to vanish like bubbles
- {水|みず}の{泡|あわ}: come to nothing

COMPOUNDS:
- {泡立|あわだ}てる: to whip, to foam
- {泡風呂|あわぶろ}: bubble bath
